scope: Non-AI compiler assignment refocus; isolated synthetic regression fixtures and read-only acceptance against the existing local account

python.notice: Expected fault-injection logs and the upstream Starlette/httpx deprecation notice are not failed assertions.

frontend.html_line_endings: LF source and generated output, enforced by scoped Git attributes

documentation.class_inventory_methods_and_relationship: Source-grounded production classes, selected real methods, and multiplicities on actual associations rather than inheritance or dependencies
documentation.rendering: Local PlantUML and LaTeX tools; no code or fieldwork uploaded to an online renderer
documentation.coursework_report_distinction: SRS, SDD and atlas are separate engineering documents, not the required 25-30-page empirical coursework report.

compiler_performance.fixture: Synthetic inputs and the exact saved, stripped public starter grammar
compiler_performance.comparison: Alternating-order, same-process cached versus uncached starter preparation
compiler_performance.unit: Microseconds per call; each sample is a batch average
limits: Measures repeated public-starter preparation only, not whole-app latency or throughput.
Does not establish a speedup for arbitrary grammars or every compiler operation.
Does not claim AI-equivalent translation or linguistic accuracy.
Earlier different-time benchmark captures are historical and have noisy unchanged controls.
Private grammars, comments, corpus text and reviewed annotations are not cached by the public-starter optimization.

preservation.contributor_and_source_location: Preview and frontend submission preserve original values; persistence retains the existing surrounding-whitespace normalization
preservation.legacy_backups_and_saved_history: Backward-compatible restoration and read/export paths retained

remaining_human_gates: Provide 10-15 genuine, manually transcribed Yaounde statements with available provenance; no invented statements count as fieldwork.
Review labels and justify a corpus-derived grammar against those statements, including accepted and rejected cases.
Capture actual analyzer evidence and complete the required report, verifying 25-30 final pages and the 30-page maximum.
Review the group presentation and complete public deployment and real-device acceptance separately if hosting is intended.
